instruction_2: Go through the archway to the right, and walk to the podium.
instruction_3: Walk down the aisle to your right, and walk forward. Take the first right and stop between the first two pillars.

instruction_1: Walk around the pews on the right, then go straight. Take a left at the wall. Stop behind the first podium.
instruction_2: walk forward then turn left, walk again then left at the corner then walk again and turn left.
instruction_3: Go left around the wooden barrier and stop once you reach the wooden barrier on the opposite corner.

instruction_1: Walk onto the platform on the right, pass two book stands. Wait between the second and the third.
instruction_2: Turn right to face an old pew and chairs. Walk up to the old chairs and turn right. Walk down the row until you reach the 5th chair.
instruction_3: Turn to the right walk into the choir loft. Walk down to the last music stand and wait.

instruction_1: Walk in front of the seats across the room and stop before the 6th seat from the left.
instruction_2: Walk past the archway and around the pew; then stand between the third and forth podium , in front of the fifth seat.
instruction_3: Go straight along on the pillars keeping to the right of them until you're passed the long wooden block, then turn right to go behind the block and then go straight and stop between the last and second to last book stand.

instruction_1: Walk through the doorway, take a left through the 2nd doorway, stop right before the plant on the right side.
instruction_2: Walk to the open door. Make a sharp right turn around the corner and walk through the open door into the room with grey tile.
instruction_3: Walk through open door and through hall, stop at bottom of stairs.

instruction_1: Exit through the doorway with the stairs. Enter the second door on the right and wait beside the potted plant.
instruction_2: Walk up the stairs, then turn right at the second doorway. Wait by the plant.
instruction_3: Go up the steps next to the minibar and continue down the hallway, until stopping after entering the last door on the right.

instruction_1: Go past a display case, through a hallway with an eye chart, into the waiting area, and stop in front of a light beige couch with six pillows.
instruction_2: Walk down the hall and make a left at the end and stop at the first room on the right. Wait in the entryway of the room with the two couches.
instruction_3: walk straight to to the end of the hall, turn left into living room, stop at the couch.

instruction_1: Exit the bedroom and turn right. Walk through the kitchen and turn left. Walk into the small room with a sink and stop near the sink.
instruction_2: Go through middle room and to the right into the room with the sink, go straight through until you come to an archway on your left make a left through it and go through the doorway and wait.
instruction_3: Exit the room and head straight then turn right and pass through the kitchen and then turn left and go into the second door on the right and stop by the sink.

instruction_1: Walk past the fridge and out of the doorway and turn left before the bathroom. Then turn left and stop in the room with two white sofas opposite each other. Stop next to the corner table with a plant on it.
instruction_2: Walk through the kitchen passing the fridge on the left. Turn left at the hall then turn left again. Wait in the room on the right.
instruction_3: Exit the kitchen and wait in the sitting room, near the loveseat.

instruction_1: Exit the kitchen and turn right. Go down the hall and wait next to the bedroom door that is second on the right.
instruction_2: Move forward through the kitchen, enter the room to the right, wait near the bedroom doorway.
instruction_3: Turn to the left and walk down the hallway to exit the kitchen. Once you reach the end of the hallway Turn right and stop in front of the last bedroom on the left. Stop in the doorway.

instruction_1: Facing the clock turn left, at the intersection turn right, before the bookshelves turn right, at the intersection turn left and turn into the doorway and stop.
instruction_2: Turn left and then turn right into the hallway. Walk straight until almost get to a room with a bookcase.Before you go to the room turn right and then turn left and go into the bathroom. Wait near the sink.
instruction_3: Leave the sitting room and go left. Take a right before you enter the foyer. Take a right before you enter the office area. Enter the bathroom on the left.

instruction_1: Make a right and exit living area, walk past living area, and kitchen, make a right toward outside patio and wait.
instruction_2: Walk right past the clock and couch. Turn right and stop to the left of the end table.
instruction_3: Turn right and go down the hallway. Pass the couches and then turn right. Wait near the coffee table.

instruction_1: With the door leading outside behind you, walk forward and turn left to go down the corridor with the eye chart towards your right. Continue past the half bath on your left and the kitchen on your right, then turn left. Enter the bedroom ahead of your though the leftmost door on the opposite wall.
instruction_2: Go straight down the hallway opposite the brown door until you get to an intersection, make a left and go straight, then make a left before the bookcase and go straight into the bedroom on the left, take a step into the bedroom and then stop.
instruction_3: Turn left down the hallway, and turn left into the sitting room. Go into the first door on the left and stop once you reach the bed.
